message.content: {"summary":"Your rationale for a Great Barrier Reef monitoring satellite is clear, Australian-focused and well written, and your dated Gantt plan is workable. To reach the top level, you need quantified mission requirements, corrected science statements, a fuller contingency plan, real preliminary results from your STK work, and a consistent reference list.","next_steps":["In Mission Concept & Rationale, state measurable requirements (ground sample distance, spectral bands, revisit, swath, data latency, lifetime). Correct the causal chain so bleaching is linked mainly to thermal stress, and restate the '30 percent more acidic' claim as a rise in hydrogen-ion concentration.","In Project Plan & Preliminary Progress, add fallbacks for launch vehicle or trajectory selection, STK licence or simulation problems, and schedule slip before 20/11. Analyse the ground segment with contact duration, data volume and downlink capacity rather than 'maybe only one is required'.","Present your STK tutorial outputs (1 to 4) with brief interpretation of what they mean for your design. To reach the top band, quantify your objectives with measurable requirements (resolution, spectral bands, revisit, swath, latency, lifetime). Correct the bleaching and acidification causal chain, restate the '30 percent' claim precisely, and replace the Nature news footnote with primary literature supporting the Asner sensor claim.","C2":"Your dated Gantt chart and task-by-task explanation tie each stage to mission segments such as launch, orbit, ground, communications and disposal, and the week 10 review buffer shows some planning for contingency. To reach the top band, add explicit fallbacks for failure of launch, orbit or STK work and for schedule slip. Analyse the ground segment properly, and link each information source to the specific tasks it supports.","C3":"You have completed desktop research on coral bleaching and four STK tutorials, which is relevant groundwork. The evidence of technical progress is currently minor, with no orbit, coverage, link-budget or payload results shown. To reach the next band, present a set of preliminary results from your STK work with brief interpretation, so the reader can see you are clearly on track for completion.","C4":"Your report has clear headings and readable prose, which gives a good base. To reach the next band, number and caption all figures and tables, keep formatting consistent, and ensure every in-text citation matches the reference list. Remove the duplicated items in Useful Links and annotate each source to show how it informs your design."}}
